csv_project_name: On Call Mechanical & Plumbing Design Support Svc
csv_agency: County of Orange Public Works / Procurement
csv_scope_of_work: OC Public Works, on behalf of the County of Orange (County) and Orange County Flood Control District (District), requires supplemental professional services to meet workload demands and project scheduling commitments in relation to Architect-Engineer (A-E) Design, Project Administration and Management Services for various projects. To supplement existing resources, County intends to issue Architect-Engineer (A-E) Mechanical and Plumbing Design Support Services Task Order Contracts for use by County and District on an "as-needed" basis. The A-E s professional services shall include but not be limited to performing evaluation, design and cost estimating of anything that impact the functions of a building or infrastructure related to heating, cooling, ventilation, machinery, plumbing and piping systems; ensuring that these items meet applicable standards & codes, and are properly installed, reliable, correctly operating and operating safely.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Programming, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Planning/Master Planning, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering

title: On-Call Mechanical and Plumbing Design Support Services
short_description: On-call A-E services for mechanical and plumbing design support for county projects.
project_scope: As-needed task order contracts for County of Orange and Orange County Flood Control District projects. Services cover evaluation, design, and cost estimating for building or infrastructure systems related to heating, cooling, ventilation, machinery, plumbing, and piping, including code compliance, installation reliability, operational performance, and safety. The notice is not tied to a specific building or structure and covers various projects over a 36-month base period.
services: Architect-engineer mechanical and plumbing design support services under task order contracts; related design, evaluation, cost estimating, project administration, and management support for various projects.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a mechanical and plumbing design support framework, not a structural or bridge-focused project.
- Scope centers on HVAC, plumbing, piping, and machinery systems, which are outside sbp's core profile.
- It is an on-call contract for various unspecified projects rather than a defined structurally demanding structure.
- Although structural engineering is listed among requested disciplines, the described contract focus is clearly MEP-oriented.
- Framework-style, as-needed service contracts without specific technical structural scope are low priority for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. The notice is for on-call professional services for multiple unspecified projects over 36 months, so no realistic project-specific construction cost can be derived from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. As an on-call task order contract for unspecified future assignments, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived from the available information.
